# B.P1 native compatibility fixtures

These immutable inputs were copied from the published `v1.2.0` baseline
(`dcc52685fd845c8d1bddde29199e799ae921cf5c` release provenance), before B.P1
added runtime-level types. They
exercise the existing `LevelFilter` native Serde representation and must not be
regenerated from B.P1 code.
